entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A powerful individual who possesses wind abilities and struggles with a dual nature, acting as the host for his alter ego, Elizah.
entities.quote: ethan's eye is glowing green and he is floating. holding wind sigils. Elizah smirks and says- claps and says -i see,the gale warden!finally decided to show up!

entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Ethan's ruthless and pragmatic alter ego who manages the darker aspects of their dual existence.
entities.quote: demonic blood ability basically as elizah is just a alter ego of ethan.so ethan made himself think like that his wind is more powerful than elizah's blood arts

entities.name: Aariz
entities.description: A student who was abandoned by his master, Ethan, due to his violent beast instinct, seeking to challenge his former master.
entities.quote: aariz fights elizah ,as he wants to fight the strongest and always hyped up for fighting strongest,always heard about elizah.but never saw him.never knew he is ethan!his old master

entities.name: Xinea
entities.description: A person whom both Ethan and Elizah seek to protect, though their methods differ.
entities.quote: before going he said -Xinea is fine,don't worry.i can protect her better than your shit kind ideology.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A childhood friend of Ethan who provides insight into Elizah's protective nature.
entities.quote: as zayn is his childhood friend.who told him that elizah only appeared when ethan is cornered.

entities.name: Grace
entities.description: A former partner of Ethan who understands the necessity of both his sides.
entities.quote: as grace used to be ethans partner once.and she is a medical student.so she knew this side of ethan.but she never mentioned.as she loved both side of him .she felt both are needed.

timeline_events.title: Aariz and Elizah Battle
timeline_events.description: Aariz fights Elizah, believing him to be an independent entity, not realizing he is his former master, Ethan.
timeline_events.quote: in season 3 mid,aariz fights elizah ,as he wants to fight the strongest and always hyped up for fighting strongest

timeline_events.title: Ethan's Integration
timeline_events.description: Ethan forgives Elizah, accepting him as a living entity rather than suppressing him, leading to the mastery of both wind and blood arts.
timeline_events.quote: he never wanted bad for ethan.he wanted to save ethan.but ethan always saw this side of him as monster.but finally he forgive elizah .basically forgiving himself from every guilt.
